description:
Spend credits.

Spends credits from one credit pack, atomically. Refused when fewer are left. `action` labels the spend for your reports; with an `Idempotency-Key` a retry never spends twice. To spend from a customer's packs together, use POST /credits/consume.

Test keys only: refused with a live key.

action.description: Your label for what the credits paid for.
